name: Hozen Facilities
description: Hozen Facilities is a block theme for a facilities management company that looks after the plant rooms, roofs and switchrooms of office campuses and civic buildings across Rotterdam, Delft, The Hague and Dordrecht. The front page sets out the contracted sites, the four hubs, how a call-out is taken, a price list in euros and the field notes. Works without WooCommerce. A floating white header card, a plant-room photograph that comes into focus beside the heading, a staggered site pair with ghost numerals and a parallax look-up band. Proza Libre for headings, Figtree for reading. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
